p_center_fallback: mean of the two bounding faces on Layers with kglob < 3
time_axis: shared; rows are written when every Layer is synchronized with the root Layer; with sample_steps = N > 0 a row is every root step whose RUN_STEP is a multiple of N; with plot_intv_stat > 0 a row is the first root step end at or after each target time; the initial and final states are always rows
flow_columns: t; then for k = 1..kglob (cell centres, bed to surface) the flow_centre_variables; then for k = 1..kglob+1 (sigma faces, bed to surface) the flow_face_variables

definitions.z: cell-centre elevation relative to still water, -Hc+sigc*D
definitions.z_face: sigma-face elevation relative to still water, -Hc+sig*D
definitions.p: non-hydrostatic pressure at the cell centre, mean of the two bounding faces 0.5*(p_face_k+p_face_k+1) (p_center = mean)
definitions.p_face: non-hydrostatic pressure on sigma faces as reported: the stage pressure, or with PRESSURE_OUTPUT = STEP_END and ORDER 2 or 3 the extrapolated step-end pressure (ORDER 0 keeps the stage pressure), filtered when PRESSURE_OUTPUT_FILTER = SMOOTH121 (see pressure_output of each layer; surface face = 0)
definitions.omega_face: volume flux through sigma faces, D*dsigma/dt
definitions.zeta_theory: analytical internal-wave interface displacement from INTERNAL_WAVE_* at the cell centre
